usage: Upload this JSON to an AI agent. For a duration-limited music generator, generate each generationSegments item separately with its copyPastePrompt, then assemble the clips using segmentGenerationPlan.
copyPastePrompt: Create an instrumental Cyberpunk EDM, synthwave, electronic workout music track for a rhythm fitness game. Mood: Energetic, futuristic, motivational and powerful. Keep exactly 125 BPM in 4/4 with no tempo changes or tempo drift. The first downbeat must be exactly at 0.000 seconds with no intro silence. Target usable duration: 406.25 seconds. Follow this structure: [0-20s] intro groove with immediate downbeat, energy 6/10, reduced arrangement, sustained pulse and clear hold/release tension; [21.25-51.25s] anthemic accent section, energy 7/10, wide clap accents, uplifting chords and strong downbeats; [52.5-82.5s] groove section, energy 5/10, clear kick and hi-hat footwork pulse, stable bass groove; [83.75-113.75s] driving verse, energy 6/10, heavy kick/snare impacts and short rhythmic stabs; [115-145s] aggressive drop, energy 7/10, sharp synth transients, distorted bass and sweeping accents; [146.25-176.25s] tension and movement section, energy 7/10, rising tension, stereo movement and impacts while keeping the beat obvious; [177.5-207.5s] groove section, energy 6/10, clear kick and hi-hat footwork pulse, stable bass groove; [208.75-238.75s] driving verse, energy 7/10, heavy kick/snare impacts and short rhythmic stabs; [240-270s] aggressive drop, energy 8/10, sharp synth transients, distorted bass and sweeping accents; [271.25-301.25s] tension and movement section, energy 8/10, rising tension, stereo movement and impacts while keeping the beat obvious; [302.5-332.5s] groove section, energy 7/10, clear kick and hi-hat footwork pulse, stable bass groove; [333.75-363.75s] driving verse, energy 8/10, heavy kick/snare impacts and short rhythmic stabs; [365-395s] aggressive drop, energy 9/10, sharp synth transients, distorted bass and sweeping accents; [396.25-406.25s] final climax and resolved ending, energy 10/10, full drums, layered synths and maximum rhythmic intensity. Treat every gap between listed phases as a short transition fill or breathing section without changing tempo. Additional direction: Use punchy drums, a clear rhythmic pulse and strong transitions between gameplay phases.. Export without leading or trailing silence so Unity can schedule it sample-accurately.

musicDirection.additionalPrompt: Use punchy drums, a clear rhythmic pulse and strong transitions between gameplay phases.
musicDirection.arrangementGoal: Music intensity and instrumentation should follow the ordered gameplay phases. Preserve a clearly audible beat for player timing.

technicalRequirements.exportFormat: WAV preferred; OGG allowed for the final Unity import
technicalRequirements.synchronizationRule: Keep the beat grid stable at the specified BPM. Do not add silence, pickup notes or tempo drift before the first downbeat.

segmentGenerationPlan.generationWorkflow: Generate every item in generationSegments separately, using that item's copyPastePrompt. Keep the same BPM, musical key, sound palette and mix across all segments.
segmentGenerationPlan.assemblyInstructions: Remove any silence added by the generator, trim or time-warp each result to exactDurationSeconds, then place it at globalStartSecond on one DAW timeline. Export the assembled timeline as one WAV file starting at 0.000 seconds.
segmentGenerationPlan.continuityRules: Middle segments must not contain an intro, outro or fade. Start on the next bar downbeat and continue the harmony, groove and instrumentation of the previous segment. Only the final segment may resolve and end.
